messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Elections, Government, political systems and organisations, and Political behaviour and attitudes in Germany during the 2020s, matching this research need: German public opinion survey data on the 2025 federal election, party preferences, coalition and chancellor evaluations, government performance, migration, economy, pensions, climate, defense, Ukraine, EU, democracy, and respondent demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS GLES 2025 post election cross section survey Germany dataset DOI
German Longitudinal Election Study 2025 campaign panel dataset GESIS
